sloka: स तु दिव्येन रूपेण मुनि पुत्रः स्व कर्मभिः ।स्वर्गमाध्यारुहत् ख्षिप्रम् शक्रेण सह खर्मवित् ॥२-६४-४८॥
transliteration: sa tu divyena rūpeṇa muni putraḥ sva karmabhiḥ ।svargamādhyāruhat khṣipram śakreṇa saha kharmavit ॥2-64-48॥

translations.english: The virtuous son of that ascetic assumed a celestial form through the merit of his good deeds and ascended heaven at once with Indra.
